matches.rationale: No finding addresses the contradiction between the SNN position error in Table 3 and the reported oscillatory/unreliable behavior, nor the lack of statistical support.
No finding discusses the warm-up indicator zeroing out the BC term in Equation 1.
No finding addresses the missing seed/evaluation-protocol specification for the ablation study in Table 4.
No finding mentions the unsupported '2.1× improvement' claim in the abstract.
No finding addresses the misattribution of the fast sigmoid surrogate gradient to the SuperSpike reference.
No finding discusses the absence of safety measures or ethical considerations for real-world drone crashes.
No finding identifies the promotional 'set to revolutionize' language in the abstract.

Finding 1 identifies the same underlying inconsistency about whether the critic receives action histories, located in Sections 3.1 and 3.4. Although the quoted direction differs slightly, both target the same critic-action-history contradiction.
No finding addresses the exaggeration of baseline rewards relative to Figure 4a.
No finding discusses the undefined reward derivative r′ in the adaptive slope scheduler.
No finding mentions the unequal training durations/epoch counts across compared methods.
No finding addresses the questionable interpretation of gradient noise as beneficial exploration for shallow slopes.
No finding discusses the unsupported energy-savings claim attributed to the DSQN/Loihi reference.
Finding 2 concerns an internal arithmetic inconsistency in Table 2 synapse counts, not the unfair capacity comparison between an ANN and a larger SNN. The scientific issues are distinct.
No finding addresses the tension between the abstract's general framing and the conclusion's guiding-policy dependency limitation.
No finding identifies the overstated 'advances theoretical understanding' claim in the conclusion.
No finding discusses the soft-reset equation's implausible negative membrane potential.
No finding addresses the missing curriculum schedule details in Table 5.
No finding discusses the unsupported sim-to-real transfer claim or absence of domain randomization/system identification.
No finding addresses the statistically implausible low variance for failed configurations in Table 4.
